dependsOn.totalReturn: canonical-total-return-1.2.0 (unchanged; whole-series reconstruct and its reasons)

perSeriesFields.adjustedPrice: provider adjustedClose: cross-check only, never a source
perSeriesFields.validityIntervals: intervals[]: VALID {from,to}, INVALID_RANGE {from,to,observedAt,resumeFrom,reason}, HOLD / QUARANTINE {from,observedAt,reason,detail,evidenceClass,outcome}, TERMINAL {from,kind OPEN|DELISTED} or listing break
perSeriesFields.quarantineHoldReason: hold.reason (core reason or CORPORATE_ACTION_CONFLICT) and hold.evidenceClass
perSeriesFields.provenance: evidence.provenanceHash, sources (accession, form, filedDate), contract versions
perSeriesFields.sourceTimestamps: SEC stageVisibleAt per stage, evidence.visibleAt, hold.observedAt; for a normalization evidence.observedAt = first session whose as-of view contains it (observedAtBasis FIRST_AS_OF_VIEW_WITH_NORMALIZATION, since 2.1.0; the stage-only timestamp is kept as observedAtStage), pitHistory discloses every earlier view as PIT_REVISION or HOLD with until/resumeFrom; hold.observedAt = first session whose as-of view contains the hold (observedAtBasis FIRST_AS_OF_VIEW_WITH_HOLD, since 2.2.0, review R2-01; earlier views disclosed as HOLD_RETROACTIVE). Measured on real data: 2.1.0 in run 38976628673; the 2.2.0 hold timestamps are not yet re-measured
perSeriesFields.pitVisibility: build(bars, {asOf}) uses bars <= asOf and SEC observations filed strictly before asOf (field by field); pitHistory() lists HOLD->resume and PIT_REVISION transitions; the final view differs from an as-of view only (a) in the event-day return of an SEC normalization not yet in that view (PIT_REVISION / HOLD with resumeFrom) and (b) in bars from hold.from that an earlier view still treats as valid (HOLD_RETROACTIVE); both are disclosed per event

states.VALID_WITH_INVALID_BARS: valid with single invalidated bars (reverted provider spikes); the series resumes after each
states.NO_VALID_BARS: identity unconfirmed or fewer than two valid bars

semantics.VALID_UNTIL: validUntil = last bar of the reconstructable prefix; the total-return index over [validFrom, validUntil] is the core reconstruction of exactly these bars
semantics.HOLD_FROM: hold.from = first bar not canonical; hold.observedAt = first day this was knowable from bars and filings up to that day
semantics.RESUME_FROM: INVALID_RANGE.resumeFrom (spike) and pitHistory().resumeFrom (a later SEC filing confirms the event)
semantics.INVALID_RANGE: bars without a valid price; returns skip them (ratio of the valid bars around)
semantics.TERMINAL: listing discontinuity (> 365 days) or series end (OPEN / DELISTED); proceeds after delisting are not estimated

consumerRules: A consumer may use a bar at date t only if isValidOn(contract, t).
Returns are ratios of valid bars; never chain across a HOLD/QUARANTINE boundary.

Point-in-time decisions (eligibility, exclusion, settlement) key on observedAt, never on hold.from; a backtest at t < observedAt treats the security as available (its bars <= t are valid in the final view and identical in the as-of view).
Consumers obtain partial series through scripts/quant/lib/daily-prices.mjs#fromBarsPartial (opt-in); fromBars keeps the whole-series semantics.
tests: quant/tests/corporate-action-v2.test.mjs (V1-V15 validity/PIT/evidence, E1-E8 SEC extraction, R-F03..R-F10 review regressions, C1-C4 daily-prices consumer)
